name: Bromo Marathon 2026
short_description: Bromo Marathon 2026 was a mountain marathon with 21K, 10K, 5K and kids' races, run on 6 September 2026 from Plataran Bromo in Tosari, East Java, Indonesia.
ai_summary: Bromo Marathon 2026, the 13th edition, was run on Sunday 6 September 2026 from Plataran Bromo in Tosari, Pasuruan Regency, East Java, Indonesia, and organised by Galanesia. It offered a 42K marathon, a 21K, a 10K, a 5K and a 2.5K kids' race on a mix of asphalt and dirt trail. The route was changed in 2026 after forest fires in the Bromo area.
pros: Mountain trail course from 1,840 m through Tengger villages, farmland and forest
Generous limits: 10 hours for the 42K and seven for the 21K
UTMB Index and ITRA points on the 10K, 21K and 42K
Official shuttles from Surabaya and Malang
cons: Aid stations 5-7 km apart on the 42K; you carry at least 1 litre and mandatory kit
Bibs must be collected in Tosari the day before; no race-day pickup
The 2026 route was changed after forest fires and lost its views of Bromo
Small marathon field: 149 runners in the 2026 42K results

research_highlights: On the organiser's published course (drawn for 2024), the full marathon starts at 1,840m altitude and climbs to around 2,469–2,491m near the 30km mark, making the middle section a significant uphill test.
The 21K half marathon has a reported elevation gain of 977 meters, described by organisers as one of Southeast Asia's most challenging half marathons.
Terrain is mixed: volcanic sand, rocky paths, forest trail, and paved roads, so trail running shoes are strongly recommended and sandals/barefoot running are banned.
Cut-off times are 10 hours for the 42K, 7 hours for the 21K, 4 hours for the 10K, and 3 hours for the 5K.
BIB collection and mandatory race briefing (for 42K/21K) happen the day before race day (Saturday) at Plataran Bromo — no same-day race packet pickup is permitted.
research_watchouts: Accommodation in Tosari is limited during race weekend, and the organiser recommends booking early.
Parking near the start/finish is limited and fills up quickly, so organisers strongly recommend using the official shuttle instead of driving.

Mandatory gear (hydration pack, rain jacket, emergency blanket, whistle, headlamp for 42K, etc.) is checked at BIB collection and may be spot-checked on course, with missing gear resulting in disqualification.
Road running shoes may lack sufficient grip on the volcanic sand and rocky sections of the course.

The 2026 route was changed after forest fires, but no 2026 route map was published; the organiser's course pages still describe the 2024 route, and its FAQ gives the 42K climb as +193m while its route file shows 1,937m of ascent.

faqs.question: When was the Bromo Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: The Bromo Marathon 2026, the 13th edition, was run on Sunday 6 September 2026. The 42K started at 6am, followed by the 21K at 6.30am, the 10K at 7am, the 5K at 7.30am and the kids' 2.5K at 7.45am. Bibs were collected in Tosari on Saturday 5 September.

faqs.question: Where is the Bromo Marathon 2026 held?
faqs.answer: The race started and finished at Plataran Bromo in Wonopolo, Ngadiwono, Tosari, in Pasuruan Regency, East Java, at about 1,840 m above sea level. The courses ran through Tengger villages, farmland and forest on the slopes of Mount Bromo, but the 2026 route did not offer views of Bromo itself.

faqs.question: What distances are offered at the Bromo Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: The 2026 edition offered five races: the 42K marathon, 21K, 10K, 5K and a 2.5K kids' race. The organiser's course pages give the lengths as 42.67 km, 20.91 km, 9.91 km, 5.08 km and 2.49 km, although those pages describe the 2024 route and the 2026 route was changed after forest fires.
